hints.title: Key Coordinate Mapping
hints.text: Record the integer position of each character on the keyboard layout.

hints.title: Sequential Distance Accumulation
hints.text: Starting from initial position 0, compute the absolute difference in position for each subsequent letter in word.

hints.title: Update Current Finger Position
hints.text: After adding the move distance, update the finger position to the current letter index and proceed to the next character.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning the keyboard string for every letter in word takes O(26 * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A fixed lookup table of length 26 maps character coordinates in O(1) time per typed character.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement constant-time character index lookup and running distance sum.
complexity.notes: Initial position of finger is index 0 on the keyboard.
